Culture, Nature & Coast

10-Day Ultimate Sri Lanka Experience

10 days / 9 nightsPrivate tour1–3 guests

From ancient kingdoms and sacred temples to misty mountains, wildlife and tropical beaches, this 10-day journey gives you a wonderful taste of Sri Lanka.

Explore the itinerary ↓
YOUR JOURNEY, DAY BY DAY

The itinerary.

DAY 01

Negombo / Colombo

Arrival, airport pickup and coastal sightseeing.

DAY 02

Sigiriya & Dambulla

Explore Sigiriya Rock Fortress and Dambulla Cave Temple.

DAY 03

Kandy

Discover Kandy and the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic.

DAY 04

Nuwara Eliya

Travel through the beautiful tea country and visit a tea plantation.

DAY 05

Ella

Enjoy Ella’s spectacular mountain scenery and visit the Nine Arch Bridge.

DAY 06

Ella

A relaxed day to explore Ella, waterfalls, viewpoints and local experiences.

DAY 07

Wildlife Safari

Travel towards Yala or Udawalawe and enjoy a wildlife safari.

DAY 08

South Coast

Continue towards Hiriketiya or Mirissa and enjoy the beach.

DAY 09

Galle

Explore historic Galle Fort and enjoy the beautiful southern coastline.

DAY 10

Galle → Colombo

Relaxed journey back to Colombo or airport transfer.

10 DAYS OF DISCOVERY

Let’s plan your journey.

A perfect choice for travellers who want to experience culture, nature, wildlife, mountains and beaches in one unforgettable journey.
